facts.fact: Yna 笔下女主用古老魔法与利刃直面暗君；现实中她顶乱发、叼冷 Pop-Tart 在厨房找鞋
facts.anchor: fierce heroines faced dark lords with ancient magic, razor-sharp daggers, and terrifying composure

facts.fact: 今天 9 月 7 日 Yna 满 40 岁；本该带来平静智慧，实际是咖啡因短缺、三个孩子三向混乱、手稿截稿日压顶
facts.anchor: Turning forty on September seventh—which happened to be today—was supposed to bring peace, wisdom, and a settled life.

facts.fact: 三个孩子：Lynne 7 岁想拿果汁盒当早饭；Michael 9 岁找到一只鞋在走廊跳胜利舞；Elizabeth 14 岁淡定煎蛋、是家中主锚
facts.anchor: Lynne, seven, was currently trying to negotiate eating a juice box for breakfast.

facts.fact: Elizabeth 以死板官腔递咖啡，警告母亲震动频率威胁房屋结构；Yna 配合接「Yes, daughter?」并感激喝下
facts.anchor: You are vibrating at a frequency that threatens structural damage to the house. Please consume the caffeine.

facts.fact: 脊医 Dr. Ron 检查写作马拉松留下的损伤，问拉伸做了没；她还没编完谎就被打断，压背整脊后如释重负
facts.anchor: Have you been doing the stretches I told you to do?

facts.fact: 排队时翻手机笔记，看到凌晨两点的开场是主角与 Thaerin 在小村咖啡馆隔着光洁桌子相遇——她自骂这是「她（女主）那个世界」的写法
facts.anchor: She had written her protagonist and Thaerin meeting across a polished table in a quaint village café.

facts.fact: 她删掉咖啡馆开场整段重写：主角第一晚就被丢进陌生世界的阴影森林，又冷又迷向、快被游荡掠食者吃掉时由 Thaerin 找到她
facts.anchor: Her protagonist needed to be thrown straight into a hostile, shadowed forest on her very first night in this foreign world—freezing, disoriented, and about to get eaten by roaming predators when Thaerin finds her.

facts.fact: 排队时她脚打拍子、口中嘶声模仿出鞘；前面持公文包的西装男僵住转身瞪她，她举手机道歉
facts.anchor: The businessman directly in front of her—a guy in a crisp coat holding a briefcase—stiffened, spun around, and stared at her like she was actively losing her mind.
